component.title: ValidationSummary
component.purpose: Summarizes recoverable field errors while preserving direct keyboard paths back to each field.

states.description: Multiple field errors with labeled recovery links.
No summary output when there are no errors.

claims.statement: Errors are exposed as an alert with a heading and field-specific links.
The component renders no summary surface when the error map is empty.
Each listed field provides a direct navigation path back to the field target.
